title: Puzzle 5d Concrete Forest Fixture
description: Add a new fixture for Concrete Forest to puzzle 5d: 2d fixture, 5d composed fixture, catalogue wiring in play.
summary: Fixed viewport zoom being far too high for Concrete Forest: parsed 2d fixtures normalize rectangles to 20px circles, so auto-fit used tiny bounds (zoom ~4.5). Viewport framing now reads authored node width/height from raw catalog JSON via puzzle2dPlayViewportCameraForFixtureId and optional rawFixture on puzzle2dPlayViewportCameraFromFixture. Framework triptych keeps catalog raw ref until user edits; 5d load uses catalog raw for nakagin/concrete-forest. Concrete Forest zoom is now ~0.42 with room to grow.
